name: java-analyzer
description: Java language support powered by the java-analyzer language server.

commands.title: Java Analyzer: Check for Server Updates

javaAnalyzer.server.path.markdownDescription: Explicit path to a `java-analyzer` executable. Leave empty (`""`) to automatically download and manage `java-analyzer` from GitHub Releases (falling back to `java-analyzer` on `PATH` when offline or updates are disabled). Any non-empty value overrides the auto-managed binary.

javaAnalyzer.server.args.description: Extra command line arguments passed to the server.

javaAnalyzer.updates.channel.description: Release channel for automatic java-analyzer binary downloads and background updates.

javaAnalyzer.trace.server.description: Traces LSP communication between VS Code and the server.
